title: Implement immutable Saved Query Asset compatibility projection runtime
goal: Implement a Go standard-library-only immutable projection of caller-owned Saved Search / Query Asset state with tenant/access/version/source/field validation and explicit compatibility diagnostics.
inputs: CAP-INV-006 canonical Saved Searches and Query Assets contract
canonical Shared Query and Search Job contracts
invariants: no canonical Saved Search or Query Asset object is invented by this bounded wave
Query remains owned by Shared Capabilities and is referenced by stable versioned identity
Search Job remains owned by Shared Capabilities
Saved View remains Shared-owned and is never merged with a Saved Search or Query Asset
Detection Rule creation/deployment/conversion remains outside this capability
OPEN-013 remains unresolved and save/share/duplicate/deprecate plus every other class-2 asset mutation is excluded
tenant scope is mandatory and cross-tenant copy is excluded
no provider, storage engine, retention policy, collaboration backend, final query dialect or final UI is selected
product-runtime/saved-query-assets access remains unavailable until E10-INV-006A-BOUNDARY registers and verifies unique runtime ownership
security_properties: caller-provided tenant and access decisions fail closed
inaccessible Query or source/field prerequisites cannot be projected as usable
compatibility diagnostics are deterministic and never synthesize missing source/field facts
execution handoff preserves original Query/version and cannot mutate the source asset
no Search Job is created or executed by the bounded runtime
acceptance_tests: caller/source input cannot be mutated or aliased by the projection
cross-tenant or denied Query references fail closed
removed/missing source or field is incompatible with named diagnostics
runtime performs no class-2 mutation and creates no Search Job
security-critical runtime coverage target is at least 90 percent
all 18 predeclared contract fixtures execute against the runtime
authorization-negative asset/query denial fixtures pass as measured security adapters
runtime Go coverage is measured by CHK-SECURITY-TESTS

performance_budget.rationale: compatibility projection is a pure local transformation independent of persistence/providers
metrics: bounded local query-asset projection p95 engineering target declared by A-BOUNDARY
no production storage or query-execution SLO claim

migration.rationale: bounded core remains persistence-neutral and performs no class-2 mutation

rollback.strategy: revert the current bounded task and keep downstream CAP-INV-006 tasks blocked
verification: no ledger claim is created before bounded closure
no Shared canonical object is mutated

definition_of_done: caller/source input cannot be mutated or aliased by the projection
cross-tenant or denied Query references fail closed
removed/missing source or field is incompatible with named diagnostics
